legacy_prhead_diagnostic.finding: SWAP 4.3.1 prhead is not the inverse of watcon on the H_ENPR rational wet branch because prhead contains only the normalized dry-VG inverse until its geometry-dependent near-saturation branch.

primary_causes: The first implementation reconstructed theta and subtracted theta_s on the narrow wet branch, causing avoidable cancellation.

The source term_105_a/term_105_ab arithmetic leaves a roughly 1e-12 normalized-water-content floating seam between mathematically equivalent dry and wet join evaluations, creating machine-level branch ambiguity in an exact inverse test.

Even after algebraic stabilization, reconstructing head from a representable water-content state becomes ill-conditioned extremely close to saturation; exploratory stabilized evaluation reduces the worst head roundtrip to about 1.7e-10 cm but still cannot satisfy the predeclared 1e-11 scaled-head criterion near h around -0.02 cm.
failure_diagnosis.interpretation: The frozen gate was intentionally strict and therefore remains failed. Its failure does not imply that the H_ENPR retention law is physically non-invertible. It shows that exact head recovery from binary64 theta arbitrarily close to saturation is the wrong runtime contract for the primary Ross2011 precomputed-flux route.

ross2011_architecture_implication.source_method: Ross2011 uses unsaturated water content as primary state and a precomputed q(v_upper,v_lower) face table; runtime face flux need not reconstruct head before every lookup.
ross2011_architecture_implication.next_runtime_mapping: Qualify direct representable S-to-table-coordinate mapping over the bounded unsaturated face-table envelope.
ross2011_architecture_implication.offline_head_reconstruction: Offline table generation may use stabilized analytical formulas and/or higher precision because iterations and expensive constitutive work are allowed offline.
ross2011_architecture_implication.pressure_output: Derived diagnostic head accuracy near saturation must be separately specified and must not silently become the flux-table admission criterion.

scope_guard: No production state-layout decision is made here. Unified-head state and mixed Ross state remain candidate architectures until transient saturation-transition and conservation gates decide between them.
